recommendation: Keep this source-changing commit. It fixes a current post-application stale reference without reintroducing core definitions or editing unrelated OID registry lines that do not define current CodeSystem resources.
issue_request: FHIR-39632 was an Applied/Persuasive CDS request to remove duplicate CodeSystem definitions from the base FHIR specification for Evidence-related terminology already defined in THO, including certainty-rating, attribute-estimate-type, statistic-type, synthesis-type, and usage-context-type.
initial_application: The main application happened before this reconciliation in caa1fb75adbcca96f92873c7d958e31f547124bb and PR 3468 merge 39d4fef037998a7441d5fd37f4faa0a3c6c6ddbe, which removed the core Evidence terminology source files that duplicated THO and rewired Evidence, ArtifactAssessment, and examples to THO terminology URLs.
additional_context: A Zulip committers thread established the duplicate CodeSystem cleanup scope before the Jira was filed. A later FHIR-45507 commit created source/datatypes/UsageContext-additional-bindings.xml after PR 3468 and used the old http://hl7.org/fhir/usage-context-type URL. UsageContext is active in source/fhir.ini, and FHIR-49931 confirms usage-context-type code maintenance belongs in THO.
reconciliation: Changed all seven UsageContext.code conditional usage codings in source/datatypes/UsageContext-additional-bindings.xml to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/usage-context-type. Current searches found no remaining active target CodeSystem definition resources for the FHIR-39632 CodeSystems.
source_changes: source/datatypes/UsageContext-additional-bindings.xml: replaced seven conditional UsageContext.code coding systems from http://hl7.org/fhir/usage-context-type to http://terminology.hl7.org/CodeSystem/usage-context-type.

related_jiras.note: Added the UsageContext additional-binding fragment after the FHIR-39632 terminology move and used the old core usage-context-type URL.
Confirms current usage-context-type code additions belong in the THO CodeSystem.
